st: Thoughts on holidays, while on holiday

sec.p: It isn't only people: it's travel itself that has vanished: we don't travel through space, but within a space. From the comfy armchair at home we move to a car seat, to the seat of a Starbucks identical all over the world, to an aeroplane seat, ending up in an IKEA-style bar in…

Maybe partly for this reason, for a few years now I've been travelling by bike, through space (cold and rainy, sometimes). So that, when I got back, the armchair at home had travelled with me: it was different too: warmer and drier, and decidedly comfier than a saddle.

Fabio Genovesi - a cycle traveller too, not by chance - goes further, though. Even travelling through space isn't enough. What we lack is adventure. Weaving together epic literature (the Odyssey, not by chance) and technology, he writes: I write with a pen. Novels, short…

Now let me tell you how I learned all this the hard way. Lured by the promise of a “gravel paradise”, this year I rode the white Alpine roads near Cuneo, discovered thanks to the beautiful alvento - destination. And it really was paradise: zero cars, loads of nature. And yet it…
